scope: Read-only audit of current assembled catalogue and bundled model index. No runtime or catalogue edits performed.

integration_issues.finding: Related links target hardware entries intentionally excluded while no usable model exists.
integration_issues.recommendation: Filter related_ids after the final entry set is assembled.

integration_issues.finding: Xbox Series X uses a model published in December 2019, explicitly called a quick mock-up by its creator. Factual note is correct, but generic object title hides the distinction if notes are not shown.
Three currently assembled hardware stops still have no model. Parent is resolving Famicom and Wii; Odyssey exact selected source is view-only.
integration_issues.recommendation: Do not claim all hardware is in 3D before these are attached or explicitly reported missing.

integration_issues.finding: Original Xbox model creator credit contains a literal question mark in Hern?ndez. Verify current author spelling against official source and preserve original embedded credit separately.
Atari thumbnail supports six-switch VCS identification but not a verified heavy-sixer versus light-sixer production subtype.
integration_issues.recommendation: Keep chronology at the 1977 platform level; do not describe this artist model as an authenticated 1977 launch specimen.

portable_model_proposals.gba_quality_note: Available original horizontal GBA has useful detailed worn surface textures but lacks several printed labels. Not as faithful as the user-selected unavailable Skribbl source. User selection required; no silent substitution.

factual_date_policy: Nintendo DSi must use its 2008 Japanese launch, not original DS 2004.
Original GBA 2001 and Advance SP 2003 are different revisions.
Original 3DS Japanese launch is February 2011; Zelda 25th Anniversary European edition is November 2011. XL and New 3DS models are distinct revisions.
NES initial North American year 1985 is not Famicom Japanese year 1983.
PAL SNES year 1992 is not Japanese Super Famicom 1990 or North American SNES 1991.
Saturn first platform release 1994 Japan should not silently imply the selected black western case was the grey Japanese launch specimen.
Year-only records deliberately retain month/day zero when a precise regional day is not established.
rights_policy: Public viewing is not a download or redistribution grant.
All bundled model files presently match their indexed SHA-256 and size.
All current image/model records have creator, licence and source metadata; full image rights were checked by upstream Commons imageinfo rather than inferred from Wikipedia.
640 Wikipedia reference records retain article revision, contributors history and CC BY-SA licence links.
Creative Commons rights in a model do not automatically cover separately embedded commercial soundtrack recordings; do not extract and redistribute their audio.
